text: Wonii kadi e luutongol jemma e ñalorma ngol, e kon ko Allah jippiniri ka kammu, immorde e ndiyam, O wuurnitiri ɗam leydi ndin, fewndo ndi yoorunoo ndi alaa puɗi, e firlitagol keneeli ɗin, yiltindira ɗi senngo kala, tuma woo, fii nafa mon, ko maandeeji non, wonannde yimɓe haqqilooɓe ɓen. Ɓe dallinora ɗum, e wootinɗingol Allah ngol, e wonnde Himo haɗtani ummitingol, O haɗtani huunde kala.
